title: B0797 warns on internal-looking fields every reader receives
why: A field is returned to every reader unless it says otherwise, so a `password_hash` or `api_key` written as plain `str` leaks without any error. The warning asks the app to state the exposure.
steps: For each field B0797 reports, write `private`, `writeonly` or `visible: [...]`; use `visible: ['public']` when it is meant to be public.
